turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to finalize the roadmap for our internal LLM monitoring tool. Do you think we should stick with static regression suites or something else?
Static regression suites are great for catching known regressions, but they can become stale quickly. What specific challenges are you facing with your current setup?

They're too slow and don't catch real-world drift. Honestly, Vincent Koc argues that AI evaluation must evolve from offline snapshots into living, intent-driven systems. I want to build towards that vision.

That is a strong framework. Moving to intent-driven evaluation means you need metrics that adapt to user goals rather than just fixed test cases. Did you order the new GPU clusters for the real-time inference engine yet?
Not yet, I'm waiting on budget approval. It's raining here, so I'm stuck inside dealing with procurement paperwork.
Procurement is always a drag. Once the budget clears, real-time evaluation will be much smoother.
Yeah. Anyway, back to the roadmap. I need a high-level plan for the Q3 deliverables based on that evaluation philosophy.
Understood. We can structure Q3 around moving from batch testing to continuous monitoring.
